system.summary: Homophonic substitution of letters by figures 2-99 (2-5 per letter, u/v and i/j merged), words ended by stops and figures joined by commas, with a few 3-4 figure code words (8674 Persia, 4040 French, 630 Bombay).
system.doubled_letters: written with two figures, often different homophones (inclosed: 98,90,80,93...; occurred, supersede)
system.sibling_key: none; not the page,word code of targets/jones1802
system.notes: Nulls 1 and 2 only in the figures of the date and in the signature. The copyists cut and join words freely.

prior_solution.where: /19: the clear text of the ninth-paragraph enclosure written in its margin at the time; /18 ff. 7-8: a later reader's pencil letters over a few words. No decipherment of the /18 letter itself found.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose Daniel Bourdeau's lead (catalogue 2649) and fetched the 40 QDL images in his Chrome; transcription, solve, held-out tests and reading by the agent. No hints on the content.
tools: simulated annealing with an English 4-gram model (verification/common.py)

solution.what: Daniel Bourdeau's Koç/Ottoman deep sweep logged IOR/L/PS/9/67/18 as catalogue 2649 (QDL, Cloudflare blocks scripts).
Transcribed /18 (9 images), /20 (6 images) and /21 image 1 from QDL images saved in Chrome; /18 and /20 found to be two copies of one letter.
Tested targets/jones1802: a page,word code book; no group of this kind here, so no value applies.
Annealed figure-to-letter maps on /18 + /20 (2640 figures, 600 words) against an English 4-gram model with word breaks kept; three restarts reached the same readable text; four values fixed by hand.
PREREG v1: held-out /21 image 1, lexical share 0.729 vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.157; bar 0.85 not met (copyists' cuts, names, u/v spellings, not misreadings). Portion burned.

PREREG v2 frozen before transcribing new text: held-out /18 images 0012-0014 (444 figures, 94 words), same frozen key, u/v and i/j allowed, names and copyists' cuts counted apart: 0.968 vs best of 200 shuffles 0.340; passed.
Read the whole letter as sentences (reading_18.md) and the enclosure (reading_21.md); the enclosure agrees with the clear text in the margin of /19.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 3844 tokens, 64 types, en-modern order 4: reading -2.21 per letter; random keys -6.693 (z 14.2); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -4.428 (mean -4.462, z 91.2); annealer on the real text -2.472. Verdict: pass.

Integration check of PR #705 (AI agent, for the maintainers; not a person): decode.py and an own decoder from key.json reproduce the four decryption files; docs/_validate.py reproduces -2.210 / -6.693 / -4.428, pass; key.json and transcription_21.txt hash as frozen in PREREG v2 and v1; the held-out text of PREREG v2 decodes as in mesure_H2.txt (91 of 94 words read by the v2 labels). The v1 and v2 metric scripts point to the contributor's local corpus and word list and were not re-run. Strict read share 646/654 = 0.988. QDL images not compared (Cloudflare 403 to curl).

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.21; polyphony 0.0; 1 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.472

reading_review.note: Read reading_18.md as English sentences: continuous and coherent from the heading to the signature. Decoded again with a decoder written for the check from key.json (+88 z, 94 e): the decryptions of /18 and /20 come out as committed and carry every passage of the reading, the copyists' cuts and slips apart. Strict count over the cipher words (two clear lines left out): 646 of 654 read (0.988); holes are the unread place in 'from ‹to› Roads', the three {Bombay}, the one {French}, authori[z]ed (88 = z, added after the measure) and the two words of the figure signature. Images not compared (QDL answers curl with a Cloudflare 403). Replaces the contributor's preliminary grade A.

texts.summary: Jones, just arrived at Bombay on the Sapphire, tells Minto that Malcolm has already gone into the Persian Gulf under Minto's authority; to avoid 'the appearance of clashing authorities in Persia' he suspends his own departure until Minto's orders, while noting that he holds the King's commission, that the French are at Tehran, and that only His Majesty's ministers can be accredited.
